data.name: Project Tsingtao
data.detailed_description:
This project is currently in the pre-production development phase. Some content will be revised or even deleted as production moves forward, especially content that bears clear references to real-world elements.

The project title is provisional and will be changed during subsequent development.

The project is currently in the project initiation stage. Everyone is welcome to visit the official website of "Ritsuai律合" to learn more about this project!

We are all masters of the story!

New AVG Project by Ritsuai · Player Co-Creation Program

Every bit of your support will shape the complete narrative!

About the Story

A graduation certificate should mark the end of an old chapter and the ticket to a brand-new life, yet he is a total exception.

He glances at the hard-won conditional admission notice lit up on his phone, then stares at endless job recruitment pages on his computer, letting out nothing but a long, exhausted sigh.

The small county where he grew up is filled with memories, yet it holds no room for him to settle down and build a life.

When he has run out of all options, his family offers him a completely unfamiliar part-time job: head to a coastal city he has never set foot in, spend an entire spring and summer there, and then start his new campus life in this seaside town.

Sea winds, sunsets, lively street scenery and unexpected tenderness are all waiting for him here. His coming-of-age story and the road ahead of him will be written entirely by your own hands!

Game Features

  • Unique AVG system 【Kirikiri KAGeXpress 3.0 Next Gen.】 that enables smooth character story cutscenes and supports a variety of fun gameplay mechanics

  • Weekly cycle life simulation: freely arrange work and spare time, and decide your own travel routes

  • Open coastal city map: freely explore all locations, develop bonds with characters through interactions, and unlock numerous casual side stories

  • Multi-branching storyline: the protagonist’s fate rests on your decisions, and different choices lead to unique growth journeys

  • Player co-creation daily narrative system: every player can become a co-builder of this seaside story (please check our official website for details)

data.short_description: An AVG project with varied, distinctive gameplay. Journey to a coastal town for spring and summer. Manage your life, explore the city, meet friends, and shape a unique coming-of-age story with every choice.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Pentium III 800 MHz or higher (1 GHz or higher recommended)
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 65536 colors (TrueColor, 16bit) or higher; 16777216 colors (FullColor) recommended
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9 compatible, supports WMA audio decoding
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Broadband internet connection required for Steam functionality
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen™ 7 9800X3D or better
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 D or better
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX 9 compatible, supports WMA audio decoding
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Broadband internet connection required for Steam functionality
